action_items: Note (not iter55 scope, pre-existing): WalletPage emits 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' React warning. Low priority; flag for cleanup.

Code-review observation: KYCBanner.jsx hides itself only via `if (status.kyc_verified) return null;` (line 28). It does NOT gate on `role==='admin'`. The spec phrases 'KYCBanner visible on … for non-admin users with kyc_status != approved' — but in the current preview env the admin user (admin@bidblitz.com) actually has kyc_status='not_started' (verified via /api/kyc/status), so the banner DOES show for admin. If admin should be exempt regardless of KYC state, add an explicit admin-role bypass either inside KYCBanner.jsx or at each page's render gate (currently only !isGuest). Otherwise, the current behavior is consistent with the kyc_verified gate.

End-to-end negative case (kyc_status='approved' → banner HIDDEN) could not be exercised because no preview user has kyc_verified=true. Verified by static code review at /app/frontend/src/components/KYCBanner.jsx:27-28. Recommended: seed one user with kyc_status='approved' to enable full coverage in future iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: KYCBanner.jsx loads /api/kyc/status on every mount of the component without caching. With banner placed on /wallet, /taxi, /blitz-transfer, /auctions, /home (5 pages), each navigation re-fetches status. Consider lifting status into a global context (KYCContext) or React-Query cache with staleTime to avoid redundant calls. Acceptable for now — endpoint is fast and small payload.

AuctionsPage.jsx Stripe-Success-Polling useEffect (lines 497-547) cleanup function only sets `cancelled=true` but does NOT clear the pending setTimeout chain. If user navigates away during polling, the next setTimeout still fires once before the `cancelled` check; harmless, but cleaner to track timer ID and call clearTimeout in the cleanup. Minor.

KYCBanner.jsx imports KYCVerificationModal eagerly even though it's only shown on tap — minor bundle-size hit. If onNavigate prop is provided (which it is on all 4 iter55 pages), the modal path is unreachable; the modal could be lazy-loaded. Cosmetic.

MarketplacePage.jsx KYCBanner addition (line 291) is currently dead code in production: /marketplace route in App.js (line 424) maps to PayDirectoryPage, not MarketplacePage. Either remove the banner import from MarketplacePage.jsx or wire up the /marketplace route to MarketplacePage. Per the request, this is acknowledged as expected — no fix needed unless route changes.

Polling endpoint contract (404 'Transaktion nicht gefunden') means the success path never short-circuits early on truly invalid session — the user waits the full 18s timeout before seeing the 'Zahlung wird verarbeitet…' fallback toast. Acceptable for happy-path Stripe (where Stripe's success_url provides a real session_id), but if a tampered URL is hit, the UX is 18s of silent polling. Consider showing the timeout toast immediately on first 404 with an error category, or a separate 'Sitzung unbekannt' toast. Minor UX nit.
